name: General Market
latest_summary_text: CryptoWeeklies publishes quantitative models across five universes: crypto, AI infrastructure equities, quantum computing equities, Bitcoin equities and the broad U.S. market. Every asset carries the same spine of models - TWAP Gravity measuring premium to the expanding lifetime cost basis, a 20/100/200 week SMA macro risk composite, log-regression valuation bands, Peak/Valley risk oscillators and a Lagrangian galaxy that sorts assets into Golden Breakout, Deep Accumulation, Euphoria and Value Trap zones by momentum against risk. Ask about a specific ticker or sector for its published levels; the models are descriptive, not advice.
latest_summary_html:
CryptoWeeklies publishes quantitative models across five universes: crypto, AI infrastructure equities, quantum computing equities, Bitcoin equities and the broad U.S. market.

Every asset carries the same spine of models: TWAP Gravity measuring premium to the expanding lifetime cost basis, a 20/100/200 week SMA macro risk composite, log-regression valuation bands, Peak/Valley risk oscillators, and a Lagrangian galaxy that sorts assets into Golden Breakout, Deep Accumulation, Euphoria and Value Trap zones by momentum against risk.

Ask about a specific ticker or sector for its published levels. The models are descriptive, not advice.
